author: Hillsborough Sun
title: Kristin Noble shares community observations and criticism of youth healthcare grants
text:
Kristin Noble, New Hampshire Representative for Hillsborough 2nd District | www.facebook.com
Kristin Noble, New Hampshire Representative for Hillsborough 2nd District | www.facebook.com
Kristin Noble, a New Hampshire State Representative, shared several posts on her social media account in early August 2025, addressing a range of topics from community observations to commentary on grant programs.
On August 4, 2025, Noble posted: "Looked like these guys had babysitting duty tonight https://t.co/gE5yuKmSBO". The following day, she commented on the subject of grants related to youth healthcare, writing on August 5: "Imagine offering grants to destroy the bodies of kids? Sick https://t.co/rNvqSgpUyu". On August 6, Noble shared another observation: "Took us a little bit to find who was screeching https://t.co/Mo9PStrGvo".
Kristin Noble serves as a state representative in New Hampshire. Her online presence often includes commentary on local events and policy issues relevant to her constituency.
